scientific_integrity: Explicit analytic proof of phase branches and weighted-Laplacian stability; finite numerical tests supplement but do not certify all parameters; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Identical oscillators on an even cycle of length at least eight, with unit cycle weights and one positive antipodal chord; the result proves existence of at least five stable phase classes, not exhaustive enumeration; nonlinear critical behavior and basin sizes unproved; literature-priority risk remains.
title: Sharp chord-induced symmetry breaking and persistent obtuse-edge sinks on even Kuramoto rings
